title: Trump denies limiting Ukraine access to Starlink network
english: President Donald Trump has rejected claims that he ordered restrictions on the Starshield internet network used by Ukraine, which had limited drone operations. While Elon Musk pointed to the Pentagon as the potential source of these service speed limits, reports suggest the decision may have originated within the White House. This incident follows rising tensions between the US and Ukraine over Kyiv's decision to resume strikes on Russian oil refineries.

Walitti buutiin kun kan uumame yeroo Yuukireen lafa suphaa boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa geggeessuu ishee itti fufuun harka wal-qabatanii hojjechuun wal-dhabdee ishee fi Ameerikaa gidduutti uumamee ture.

title: Students in Europe are rising up to call for better education
english: Students across various European nations are participating in protests to advocate for significant improvements to their national education systems. In Albania, the government has responded to the unrest by claiming that outside actors are influencing the demonstrators. These protests highlight growing student frustration with current academic conditions and policies throughout the region.

title: Food affordability fears plague Gaza as Israel halts commercial goods
english: Gaza is facing a worsening humanitarian crisis as the entry of essential commercial goods like food and winter clothing has been blocked for two days. This stoppage stems from a tax disagreement between local business owners and the governing authorities in the territory. Residents are now deeply concerned that these supply disruptions will cause prices to surge amid an already severe economic collapse and widespread hunger.

title: Oregon community mourns victims of school shooting
english: A community in Bend, Oregon, is grieving after a tragic shooting at an elementary school left three children and one teacher dead. A 16-year-old attacker forced his way into the building by shooting through locked doors. The incident ended when another individual, who had pursued the teenager into the school, killed him.

oromo: Godina Bend, Oregon keessatti manneen barnoota sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti balaa dhukaasaa mudateen ijoolleen sadii fi barsiisaan tokko lubbuun isaanii darbuun isaa hawaasicha gadda keessa galcheera. dargaggeessi umuriin isaa 16 ta'e tokko balbala cufamee ture rasaasaan cabsee mana barnootichaa keessa seenuun miidhaa kana geessiseera. Dargaggeessicha duukaa bu'ee mana barnootichaa keessa kan seene namni tokko isa ajjeesuun balaan sun dhaabateera.

title: AOC transfers $1m to Michigan candidate El-Sayed in progressive push
english: Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez has donated $1 million to support Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed's campaign. She stated that this significant financial backing is intended to counter the discriminatory attacks and smears directed at El-Sayed due to his background and political views. This move highlights a major effort by progressive leaders to bolster El-Sayed’s lead against his Republican opponent ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አባል አሌክሳንድሪያ ኦካሲዮ-ኮርቴዝ በሚቺጋን የሴኔት እጩ ለሆኑት አብዱል ኤል-ሳዬድ የምረቃ ዘመቻ አንድ ሚሊዮን ዶላር ድጋፍ አድርገዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የተደረገው በኤል-ሳዬድ ማንነት እና የፖለቲካ አመለካከት ላይ ያነጣጠረውን አሉታዊ ዘመቻ ለመከላከል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት መጪውን የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ አስመልክቶ የሪፐብሊካን ተፎካካሪያቸውን እየመሩ የሚገኙትን ኤል-ሳዬድን ለማጠናከር የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Miseensi Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Amerikaa Aleksandriyaa Okasiyo-Korteziin, dorgomaa Senaatii Miishigan kan ta'an Abduls El-Saayediif deeggarsa maallaqaa miliyoona tokko kennaniiru. Gumaachi kun kan taasifameef, sababa eenyummaa fi ilaalcha siyaasaa El-Saayedirratti duula suukanneessaa gaggeeffamaa jiru ittisuuf akka ta'e ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun dorgomaa Paartii Ripaabilikaanii kanneen dursaa jiran El-Saayediin filannoo dhufuuf qophii guddaa taasisuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Trump told new press secretary to ‘reconsider’ role
english: White House press secretary Katie Zacharia is stepping down after serving in the position for less than a week. President Donald Trump advised her to rethink her appointment due to the intense pressure and criticism she faced from the public and the media. Her departure marks a very short tenure in this high-profile role.

Gadii ba'uun isaanii kun bakka hojii olaanaa kana irratti yeroo gabaabaa qofa akka turan mul'isa.

title: US weighs lifting sanctions on Iran's 'shadow fleet' to address surging costs
english: The U.S. government is exploring the possibility of easing sanctions on a network of oil tankers known as the 'shadow fleet' that are currently linked to Iran and Russia. Officials hope this move will lower record-high shipping costs and stabilize fuel prices ahead of the upcoming elections. By allowing these vessels to operate freely or carry non-sanctioned goods, the administration aims to improve the global flow of energy resources.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በአሁኑ ወቅት ከኢራን እና ከሩሲያ ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸውን 'ጥላ መርከቦች' ላይ የጣለውን ማዕቀብ ለማቃለል እያጤነ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በምርጫ ወቅት እየጨመረ የመጣውን የነዳጅ እና የትራንስፖርት ወጪ ለመቀነስ ነው። እነዚህ መርከቦች ያለምንም ገደብ እንዲሰሩ ወይም ህጋዊ የነዳጅ ምርቶችን እንዲያጓጉዙ በመፍቀድ የኢነርጂ አቅርቦትን ለማረጋጋት ታቅዷል።

Tarkaanfiin kun kanneen uumame kanneen gatiin boba'aa fi geejjibaa yeroo filannoo gahuu isaa wajjin walqabatee fooyyessuufi. Markaboonni kun akka bilisaan socho'anii fi meeshaalee heyyama qaban akka fe'an hayyamuun, dhiyeessiin boba'aa addunyaa akka tasgabaa'u abdii godhatameera.

title: Hormuz controlled by US and allies, not Iran: Centcom chief
english: The head of US Central Command stated that the US and its allies, rather than Iran, hold control over the Strait of Hormuz. By blocking Iranian ports, the US has severely hampered Iran's oil exports and reduced its influence in the region. Meanwhile, American forces continue to facilitate the secure passage of over a billion barrels of oil for regional partners through this vital waterway.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም አዛዥ የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ቁጥጥር በኢራን ሳይሆን በአሜሪካ እና በአጋሮቿ እጅ እንደሚገኝ አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ በኢራን ወደቦች ላይ የጣለችው ማዕቀብ የኢራንን የነዳጅ ንግድ በመጉዳት በአገሪቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል። በሌላ በኩል የአሜሪካ ጦር ለአጋር አገሮች ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የነዳጅ ጭነት በሰላም እንዲያልፍ በማድረግ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Ameerikaa (Centcom) akka ibsetti, dhiibbaan fi to'annoon daandii galaana Hormuz kan jiru harka Ameerikaa fi michoota ishee malee kan Iiraan miti. Gama biraan, waraanni Ameerikaa daandii kana irratti gargaarsa gochuudhaan biyyoonni ollaa boba'aa isaanii nagaadhaan akka ergatanii fi galfatan taasisuu isaa ibsameera.

title: Saudi Arabia says Houthi attacks violate terms of rapprochement with Iran
english: Saudi Arabia has formally accused Iran of supporting Houthi militant attacks, claiming this behavior violates the diplomatic agreement established between the two nations last year. A senior Saudi official stated that Tehran is failing to honor its commitment to stop arming and training these groups as part of the Beijing-brokered deal. This public criticism highlights growing tension in the Saudi-Iranian relationship as the ongoing conflict in Yemen continues to disrupt regional stability.

amharic: የቻይና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዋንግ ዪ እስራኤል በምዕራብ ባንክ የምታደርገውን የሰፈራ ማስፋፊያ እንድታቆም ጠየቁ። የፍልስጤም ጉዳይ የዘመናችን ትልቅ ታሪካዊ በደል ነው ያሉት ሚኒስትሩ፣ ለሰላም የሁለት መንግስታት መፍትሄ ቁልፍ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። በተጨማሪም ወደ ጋዛ የሚደረገው የሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅርቦት እንዲቀላጠፍ እና አለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት እንዲሰራ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Chaayinaa Wang Yi, Israa'el qubannaa lafa Qaxxaamura Lixaa irratti babal'isaa jirtu akka dhaabdu gaafataniiru. Dhimmi Falasxiin miidhaa seenaa keessatti hanga har'aatti furmaata hin argatin guddaa ta'uu ibsuun, nagaaf furmaanni 'mootummaa lamaa' murteessaa ta'uu dubbatan. Kana malees, gargaarsi namoomaa hatattamaan gara Gaazaatti akka galu akkasumas hawaasni addunyaa marii diippilomaasii deebisuuf tumsuu akka qabu gaafataniiru.

title: Residents douse workers with flaming gasoline during eviction in Peru
english: In the city of Huancayo, Peru, residents of a condemned building violently resisted an eviction attempt by officials. During the confrontation, the occupants threw burning gasoline at the workers, resulting in serious burn injuries for nine individuals. The incident was captured on video by a witness at the scene.
amharic: በፔሩ ሁዋንካዮ ከተማ ውስጥ የአንድ አደጋ ስጋት ያለበት ህንፃ ነዋሪዎች ከህንፃው እንዲለቁ ሲጠየቁ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አሳይተዋል። በዚህ ግጭት ወቅት ነዋሪዎቹ በቦታው የነበሩትን ሰራተኞች በእሳት በተያያዘ ቤንዚን በመደብደባቸው ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ አስደንጋጭ ድርጊት በአካባቢው በነበረ ሰው በቪዲዮ ተቀርጿል።
oromo: Magaalaa Huwaankayoo kan biyya Peru keessatti, jiraattonni mana jireenyaa tokko kan badii irra jiru jedhamee murteeffame, humnoonni mootummaa yeroo isaan ari'uuf yaalanitti haleellaa hamaa raawwatan. Jiraattonni kun hojjettoota irratti banzinii ibiddaan qabsiifame darbachuun, namoota sagal irratti gubaan cimaan ga'ee jira. Gochi kun namoota naannicha turaniin suuraan kan waraabame dha.

title: Argentine students protest on campus over Milei’s austerity
english: Students and professors at the University of Buenos Aires are occupying campus buildings to protest President Javier Milei's severe budget cuts. They argue that reduced government funding and low wages are damaging the quality of public education and forcing talented teachers to leave. While the administration claims their economic plan is stabilizing the country, demonstrators fear these austerity measures will permanently harm Argentina's academic future.
amharic: የቡዌኖስ አይረስ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎች እና መምህራን በፕሬዝዳንት ጃቪየር ሚሌይ የተደረጉትን ከፍተኛ የበጀት ቅነሳ በመቃወም የካምፓስ ህንጻዎችን ተቆጣጥረዋል። የመንግስት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ማነስ እና ዝቅተኛ ደመወዝ የትምህርት ጥራትን እየጎዳ እና ብቁ መምህራንን ከዩኒቨርሲቲው እንዲወጡ እያደረገ ነው ብለዋል። የሀገሪቱ አስተዳደር የኢኮኖሚ እቅዱ ስኬታማ እንደሆነ ቢናገርም፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በአርጀንቲና የከፍተኛ ትምህርት ዘርፍ ላይ ዘላቂ ጉዳት እንደሚያስከትሉ በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Barattoonni fi barsiisonni Yuunivarsitii Bu'eenos Ayirees, sagantaa qusannoo maallaqa kan pirezidaant Jaaviyeer Miileey irratti mormii guddaa kaasaniiru. Hojiin mootummaan baajata xiqqeessuu fi mindaa barsiisotaa gadi buusuun isaa, qulqullina barnoota mootummaa miidhaa jiraachuu fi barsiisonni gahumsa qaban gadi akka bahan dirqisiisaa akka jiru ibsaniiru. Mootummaan tarkaanfiin kun diinagdee biyyattii tasgabbeessaa jira jedhee kan amanu ta'us, mormitoonni garuu tarkaanfiin kun gara fuulduraatti barnoota biyyattii miidhuu danda'a jedhanii sodaatu.

title: Peshawar mourns children killed in school roof collapse
english: A tragic school roof collapse in Peshawar, Pakistan, has resulted in the deaths of at least 34 children and one teacher. Dozens of others were injured in the incident, which local authorities believe was caused by poor building construction. Thousands of people have gathered to mourn and hold funeral prayers for the victims.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ፔሻዋር ከተማ በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት ጣሪያ በመደርመሱ ቢያንስ 34 ህጻናት እና አንድ አስተማሪ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው ከ50 በላይ ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ የፖሊስ የመጀመሪያ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው የህንጻው ደካማ የአሰራር ጥራት ለዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ምክንያት ሆኗል። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎችም ለተጎጂዎች የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓት ተገኝተዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Peshawar, Pakistanitti mana barumsaa tokko keessatti ceephoon gubbaa dhoohuu isaatiin ijoolleen 34 fi barsiisaan tokko lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Namoonni 50 ol ta'an miidhaan irra ga'e yoo ta'u, qorannoon poolisii akka agarsiisutti sababaan isaatiin ijaarsa mana kanaa kan cimaa hin turre jedhameera. Namoonni kumaatamaan lakka'amanis aaddaa gaddaa fi sirna awwaalchaa kana irratti hirmaataniiru.

title: Progressives, AIPAC and the future of the Democratic Party
english: Mehdi Hasan hosts a debate on the future of the Democratic Party and its electoral prospects ahead of the midterm elections. The discussion explores whether the party's potential success stems from its own popularity or the weaknesses of their political opponents. Panelists also analyze how internal ideological divisions and the stance on Israel influence the party's future direction.
amharic: ሜህዲ ሀሰን በመካከለኛው የምርጫ ውድድር ዙሪያ የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲን የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ እና የምርጫ ተስፋዎች በተመለከተ ውይይት መርተዋል። ውይይቱ የፓርቲው ስኬት የመነጨው ከራሱ ተወዳጅነት ነው ወይስ ከተቃዋሚዎቹ ድክመት የሚለውን ነጥብ ይፈትሻል። በተጨማሪም ተሳታፊዎቹ የውስጥ አስተሳሰብ ልዩነቶች እና በእስራኤል ጉዳይ ላይ ያለው አቋም በፓርቲው መጻኢ አቅጣጫ ላይ ምን ያህል ተጽዕኖ እንደሚያሳድሩ ይወያያሉ።
oromo: Mehdii Hasan, filannoo giddu galeessaatti dura adeemsa Diimookraatik Paartii fi abdii isaanii irratti marii gaggeesseera. Mariin kun milkaa'inni paartichaa beekamtii isaan qaban irraa dhufuu moo dadhabina morkattoota isaanii irraa dhufuu akka ta'e qorata. Akkasumas, hirmaattoonni garaagarummaan yaadaa keessoo fi ejjennoon Israa'el irratti qaban gara fuulduraatti paarticha irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabaatu irratti mari'atu.

title: Iraq parliament approves al-Zaidi’s cabinet amid growing economic concerns
english: The Iraqi parliament has finalized Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s cabinet by confirming several key ministers and deputy prime ministers. This move includes the appointment of officials facing U.S. sanctions, highlighting complex political dynamics within the region. The government now faces urgent pressure to manage a severe economic crisis caused by regional conflict, which has significantly disrupted the country’s oil exports and government revenue.
amharic: የኢራቅ ፓርላማ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አሊ አል-ዛይዲን ካቢኔን በሙሉ በማፅደቅ የመንግስት ምስረታውን አጠናቋል። በዚህ ሂደት በአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ የተጣለባቸው ግለሰቦች ወደ ከፍተኛ የኃላፊነት ቦታዎች መሾማቸው የአገሪቱን ውስብስብ ፖለቲካዊ ሁኔታ ያሳያል። አዲሱ መንግስት በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት በዘይት ምርት እና በኢኮኖሚው ላይ ባደረሰው ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ወድቋል።
oromo: Paarlaamaan Iraaq ministira muummee Alii Al-Zayidii kanneen hafan muuduun guutuu kabineetii isaa mirkaneesseera. Muudamni kun namoota adabbii Ameerikaa jala jiran of keessatti kan qabatu yoo ta'u, kunis haala siyaasaa biyyattii kan mul'isudha. Mootummaan kun guddina diinagdee cimaa fi dhiibbaa waraana naannichaa irraa maddu furuuf qormaata guddaa keessa jira, kunis oomisha boba'aa fi galii mootummaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: Iran war live: Saudi blasts Houthi ‘war crimes’; US warns on Saudi airports
english: Saudi Arabia has officially condemned recent Houthi attacks, labeling them as war crimes that threaten holy sites and pilgrims. In response to the escalating regional tensions, the US embassy in Saudi Arabia has issued a security alert warning of possible strikes against Saudi airports. As a precautionary measure, American embassy staff have been restricted from traveling to certain locations.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚፈጸሙትን ጥቃቶች የተቀደሱ ስፍራዎችን እና ምዕመናንን አደጋ ላይ የሚጥሉ የጦር ወንጀሎች በማለት አውግዛለች። በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት ተከትሎ የአሜሪካ ኤምባሲ በሳውዲ አረቢያ አየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ ጥቃት ሊሰነዘር እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል። በዚህም ሳቢያ የአሜሪካ ኤምባሲ ሰራተኞች ወደ ተወሰኑ ቦታዎች እንዳይጓዙ ገደብ ተጥሎባቸዋል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan haleellaa garee Huutii gaggeeffamaa jiru, bakkeewwan qulqulluu fi namoota haajjiif deeman balaa keessa kan buusuu fi yakka waraanaa ta'uu ibsitee jirti. Gara fuula duraatti walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa hamachaa dhufuun isaa, ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa gar-tokkee biyyattii keessatti bakkeewwan xiyyaaraa irratti haleellaan raawwatamuu akka malu akeekkachiiseera. Kanaafuu, hojjettoonni ambaasaaddarichaa gara bakkeewwan tokko tokkotti imaluu akka hin dandeenye dhorkaan godhameera.

title: Two Syrian pipelines damaged amid spate of attacks on energy infrastructure
english: Two major pipelines in Syria were recently damaged in separate incidents involving a suspected sabotage attack and a fuel theft attempt. The state petroleum company reported that an explosion hit a gas pipeline in Hasakah, while another oil line near Homs experienced a leak. Despite these disruptions, officials stated that alternative arrangements have been made to maintain energy supplies to power stations.
amharic: በሶሪያ በቅርቡ በተፈጸሙ ሁለት የተለያዩ ድርጊቶች የነዳጅ እና የጋዝ መስመሮች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የመንግስት የነዳጅ ኩባንያ እንደገለጸው፣ በአንደኛው አካባቢ በታቀደ የጥፋት ድርጊት ፍንዳታ የተከሰተ ሲሆን በሌላኛው ደግሞ ነዳጅ ለመስረቅ በተደረገ ሙከራ የቧንቧ መስመሩ ተጎድቷል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ችግሮች ቢኖሩም፣ ባለስልጣናት የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫዎች የኃይል አቅርቦታቸውን እንዳያቋርጡ አማራጭ የመፍትሄ እርምጃዎች መወሰዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Siriyaa keessatti miidhaan qaamolee dhiyeessii boba'aa fi gaazii lama irra ga'uun gabaasameera. Dhaabbanni boba'aa biyyattii akka ibsetti, gaazii fi boba'aan kan darbu qaxxaamura lafaa lama keessaa tokko weerara saboota shira raawwataniin yoo miidhau, inni lammaffaan immoo hattoota boba'aatiin miidhameera. Rakkoolee kana hundaayyuu, mootummaan buufataalee humna ibsaa fiduuf dhiyeessiin jijjiiramaa akka jiruu fi hojiin suphuu akka itti fufe ibseera.

title: At least 4, including 3 children, killed in US elementary school shooting
english: A tragic shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, resulted in the deaths of at least four people, including three children. The suspect responsible for the attack was killed by gunfire shortly after police arrived at the scene. Authorities are currently evacuating the school as they conduct a thorough investigation into this devastating event.
amharic: በኦሪገን ግዛት፣ ቤንድ በተባለች ከተማ በሚገኝ ሲልቨር ሬይል የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጸመ የጥይት ተኩስ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል፤ ከእነዚህም መካከል ሦስቱ ሕፃናት ናቸው። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው ግለሰብ ፖሊስ በደረሰ በጥቂት ደቂቃዎች ውስጥ በተወሰደበት እርምጃ መሞቱ ተገልጿል። ባለሥልጣናት በትምህርት ቤቱ ውስጥ ፍተሻ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩን በቅርበት በመከታተል ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magalaa Bend, kanatti argamu mana barumsa sadarkaa tokkoffaa Silver Rail irratti dhukaasa banameen lubbuun namoota afur yoo darbu, isaan keessa sadii ijoollee dha. Namni shakkamaa kun erga poolisiin iddoo sana gahee booda rasaasaan rukutamee ajjeefameera. Qaamoleen nageenyaa mana barumsichaa keessa qulqulleessaa fi qorannoo geggeessaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, rakkoo kana gaddisiisaa ta'e kana hordofaa jiru.

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: Tigrayan nationalism has successfully mobilized the people for survival but has failed to establish a stable, law-bound governing system. While the region has endured immense suffering and war, these events have not yet been transformed into a sustainable political order beyond party control. The author argues that Tigray must now shift from merely liberating itself to building lasting institutions that empower citizens rather than military or political factions.
amharic: የትግራይ ብሔርተኝነት ህዝብን ለህልውና በማስተባበር ረገድ ስኬታማ ቢሆንም፣ ዘላቂና ህግን መሰረት ያደረገ የአስተዳደር ስርዓት ለመገንባት ግን ተቸግሯል። በጦርነቱ የደረሰው ከፍተኛ የሰብአዊ ቀውስና ስቃይ አሁን ባለው የፖለቲካ ትርክቶች ውስጥ ተገቢውን ቦታ አላገኘም። በመሆኑም ትግራይ ከነጻነት ትግል ወደ ጠንካራና የህግ የበላይነት ወዳለበት የፖለቲካ ተቋማዊ ግንባታ መሸጋገር እንዳለባት ይሞግታል።
oromo: Bihinummaan Tigiraay uummata isaanii jiraachisuuf walitti qabuun milkaa'us, sirna bulchiinsa seeraa irratti hundaa'e dhaabuuf garuu rakkoo qaba. Waraanaafi miidhaan uummaticha irra ga'e, hanga ammaatti akka furmaata siyaasaa tasgabbaa'aa ta'eetti hin jijjiiramne. Kanaafuu, Tigiraay qabsoo bilisummaa irraa gara ijaarsa dhaabbilee cimaa kan seeraan hogganamuufi uummata fayyaduutti ce'uun akka ishee barbaachisu barruun kun ibsa.

title: Bus hits train stopped on French side of  Channel Tunnel, with 19 injured
english: A bus carrying truck drivers collided with a stationary freight train near the French entrance of the Channel Tunnel, leaving 19 people injured. Two of the victims suffered serious injuries and required helicopter transport, though none of the injuries are considered life-threatening. Despite the crash, tunnel operations for freight and Eurostar passenger services remain largely unaffected.
amharic: የጭነት መኪና አሽከርካሪዎችን የያዘ አውቶቡስ በፈረንሳይ በኩል ባለው የቻናል ዋሻ መግቢያ አቅራቢያ የቆመ የጭነት ባቡርን በመግጠሙ 19 ሰዎች ቆሰሉ። ከጉዳቱ ጋር በተያያዘ ሁለት ሰዎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በሄሊኮፕተር ወደ ሆስፒታል የተወሰዱ ሲሆን፣ የሁሉም ጉዳተኞች ህይወት ከአደጋ ነጻ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ይህ አደጋ ቢከሰትም፣ በዋሻው ውስጥ የሚደረገው የጭነት እና የዩሮስታር የባቡር አገልግሎት በተለመደው ሁኔታ መቀጠሉ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Konkolaataan busii ootuu fe’umsaa fe’u tokko gara Faransaayiitti daangaa 'Channel Tunnel' biratti baabura dhaabbataa tures wajjin walitti bu’ee, namoonni 19 miidhamaniiru. Namoota miidhaman keessaa lama irratti miidhaan cimaan waan gaheef xiyyaaraan gara hospitaalaatti ergamaniiru, ta’us lubbuun isaanii sodaa keessa akka hin jirre ibsameera. Balaan kun yoo mudateyyuu, tajaajilli baaburaa fe’umsaa fi imaltootaa 'Eurostar' kan naannichatti adeemsifamu guutumaan guutuutti akka hin danqamne beekameera.

title: Israel halts commercial goods from entering Gaza; Hamas denies tax claims
english: Israel has stopped all commercial shipments into Gaza, cutting off essential supplies like fruit and clothing for the territory's 2.1 million residents. Israeli officials claim the halt follows a tax dispute, accusing Hamas of imposing unfair fees on incoming goods. Hamas has denied these allegations, calling them misinformation and stating that any contributions were voluntary and intended to support vulnerable citizens.
amharic: እስራኤል ወደ ጋዛ የሚገቡ የንግድ ዕቃዎችን ማገዷን ተከትሎ፣ ለጋዛ ነዋሪዎች አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የምግብ እና የልብስ አቅርቦቶች ተቋርጠዋል። እስራኤል ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደችው ሀማስ በንግድ ዕቃዎች ላይ ተጨማሪ ቀረጥ በመጫኑ ምክንያት ነው ስትል ትከሳለች። ሀማስ በበኩሉ ይህንን ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ የተጠየቀው ክፍያ በፈቃደኝነት ላይ የተመሰረተ እና ለችግረኞች መርጃ የሚውል እንደሆነ ገልጿል።
oromo: Israa'el meeshaaleen daldalaa gara Gaazaatti akka hin galle erga uggurtee booda, jiraattoota miliyoona 2.1 ta'aniif meeshaaleen barbaachisoo ta'an akka nyaataa fi uffataa akka hir'atan ta'eera. Israa'el tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, Hamas meeshaalee seenan irratti gibira cimaa akka buuse himuunidha. Hamas garuu himata kana haaluun, kaffaltiin sun fedhiidhaan kan godhamuu fi namoota harka qalleeyyii gargaaruuf kan qophaaye ta'uu ibseera.

title: Man United’s Martinez apologises for outburst after talks with Carrick
english: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez has issued an apology following his public criticism of the club's management after a Champions League loss. After meeting with manager Michael Carrick and team executives, Martinez admitted that his post-match comments were made out of frustration and were poorly timed. The player expressed his commitment to the club's goals and insisted that he wants to move past the incident to focus on team unity.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ዩናይትዱ ተከላካይ ሊሳንድሮ ማርቲኔዝ በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ሽንፈት በኋላ ክለቡን ይፋዊ በሆነ መንገድ በመተቸቱ ይቅርታ ጠየቀ። ከቡድኑ አሰልጣኝ ሚካኤል ካሪክ እና ከከፍተኛ አመራሮች ጋር ከተወያየ በኋላ፣ ተጫዋቹ የቁጣ ስሜት በተንጸባረቀበት ጊዜ የተናገራቸው ነገሮች ተገቢ እንዳልነበሩ አምኗል። ማርቲኔዝ ለክለቡ ስኬት አብሮ ለመስራት ያለውን ፍላጎት በመግለጽ፣ ይህንን አለመግባባት በስተጀርባ ትቶ በቡድን አንድነት ላይ ብቻ ለማተኮር ወስኗል።
oromo: taphataan ittisaa Manchestar Yunaayitid Lisandro Martiineez, injifatama Chaampiyoons Liigii booda hogganoota kilabichaa irratti qeeqaa erga dhageessee booda dhiifama gaafateera. Leenjisaa Maayikil Kaarik fi itti gaafatamtoota kilabichaa waliin erga mari'atanii booda, Martiineez yaada isaanii ibsuun akka irra darbee fi yeroo sirrii hin taane akka ture hubateera. Taphataan kun galii kilabichaa milkeessuuf waliin hojjechuuf fedhii qabaachuu isaa ibsee, rakkoo kana boodatti dhiisee tokkummaa garee irratti xiyyeeffachuuf murteesseera.

title: Trump administration sues California over noncitizens on voter rolls
english: The Trump administration has filed a lawsuit against California for failing to verify the citizenship status of approximately 20,000 registered voters before an upcoming election deadline. Federal officials claim these individuals are ineligible noncitizens and are asking the court to stop their mail-in ballots from being counted. However, California Secretary of State Shirley Weber argues the federal data is unreliable and states that her office never received the formal list, calling the demand an attempt to suppress valid voters.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በካሊፎርኒያ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚገኙ ወደ 20,000 የሚጠጉ መራጮች የዜግነት ሁኔታቸው ስላልተረጋገጠ ክስ መስርቷል። የፌዴራል ባለስልጣናት እነዚህ ሰዎች ዜግነት የሌላቸው ናቸው በማለት በፖስታ የሚላኩ ድምጾቻቸው እንዳይቆጠሩ ጠይቀዋል። የካሊፎርኒያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሸርሊ ዌበር በበኩላቸው፣ የፌዴራል መንግስቱ የሚያቀርበው መረጃ ያልተረጋገጠ መሆኑን እና ዝርዝሩን ለጽህፈት ቤታቸው እንዳልላኩ በመግለጽ፣ ይህ እርምጃ ህጋዊ መራጮችን ለማፈን የሚደረግ ሙከራ ነው ሲሉ ተችተዋል።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Doonaald Traamp, Kaalifoorniyaan filattoota 20,000 ta'an kanneen lammiilee biyya biraa ta'uu malu jedhamanii shakkituuf mirkaneeffannoo akka kennituuf himata irratti banateera. Abbaan taayitaa federaalaa namoonni kun lammiilee biyyaa miti jechuun sagaleen isaanii akka hin lakkaa'amne gaafataniiru. Haa ta'u malee, ministirri dhimma alaa Kaalifoorniyaa Shaarli Weebarii, ragaan federaalaa kan hin amanamnee fi liiistichi gara biiroo isaanitti akka hin ergamne ibsuun, tarkaanfiin kun mirga filattootaa ukkaamsuf kan karoorfame ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Several people dead or missing after Istanbul floods
english: Heavy rainfall has caused devastating flooding across Istanbul, resulting in at least three fatalities and multiple people missing. The severe weather has overwhelmed the city, causing widespread damage to homes and local businesses. Residents are currently facing significant challenges, including utility outages and the difficult process of cleaning up the aftermath.
amharic: በኢስታንቡል ከተማ በጣለ ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት በተከሰተ ጎርፍ ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ሌሎች በርካታ ሰዎችም የት እንዳሉ አይታወቅም። ጎርፉ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን እና የንግድ ተቋማትን በማጥለቅለቁ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች የኤሌክትሪክ እና የውሃ መቆራረጥ ችግር እንዲሁም የጽዳት ስራዎችን በማከናወን ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Roobni cimaan magaalaa Istaambulitti roobe lolaa hamaa uumee, namoonni yoo xiqqaate sadii lubbuun darbanii fi kanneen biroon hedduun immoo bakka buutan dhabameera. Lolaan kun manneenii fi bakkeewwan daldalaa hedduu miidhee jira. Namoonni naannichaa amma tajaajila elektirikii fi bishaanii dhabuun akkasumas miidhaa lolaan qaqqabsiise qulqulleessuudhaan rakkoo hamaa keessa jiru.

title: Israeli ‘ad’ firm helped infect spyware into Al Jazeera devices
english: An Israeli company masquerading as a digital advertising firm has been linked to the deployment of spyware. This malicious software was used to infiltrate and infect the devices of journalists working at Al Jazeera and other organizations. The incident highlights the growing threat of sophisticated digital surveillance tools targeting media professionals.
amharic: እንደ ዲጂታል ማስታወቂያ ድርጅት የሚታየው አንድ የእስራኤል ኩባንያ የስለላ ሶፍትዌር በመጠቀም ጋዜጠኞችን ሲሰልል መገኘቱ ተጋልጧል። ይህ አደገኛ ሶፍትዌር አልጀዚራን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ተቋማት የሚሰሩ ጋዜጠኞች መሳሪያዎች ውስጥ በመግባት መረጃዎችን ሲሰርቅ ቆይቷል። ይህ ድርጊት በጋዜጠኞች ላይ እየተፈጠረ ያለውን የዲጂታል ሰላዮች ስጋት ያሳያል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Israa'el tokko akka dhaabbata beeksisatti of fakkeessuun, meeshaa namoota basaasu itti fayyadamee jira. Sooftiweerii miidhaa geessisu kana fayyadamuun, gaazexeessota Al Jazeera fi dhaabbilee biroo irratti qophiin basaasummaa raawwatameera. Gochi kun, ogeeyyota miidiyaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo nageenya dijitaalaa guddaa ta'e akka jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Rubio spoke to Lebanese president about confiscated Hezbollah explosives, says official
english: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio recently contacted Lebanese President Aoun to discuss a large cache of explosives seized from Hezbollah. Rubio insisted that these materials must not be returned to the group and demanded that those responsible for the shipment face consequences. This communication follows reports that the Houthis recently admitted to owning the 500 kilograms of explosives captured by Lebanese officials.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ከሊባኖስ ፕሬዝዳንት አውን ጋር በስልክ ተነጋግረዋል። በውይይቱም ከሂዝቦላህ የተያዙ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ኪሎ ግራም ፈንጂዎች ለቡድኑ መመለስ እንደሌለባቸው አሳስበዋል። እንዲሁም ለዚህ ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት ተጠያቂ የሆኑ አካላት በህግ እንዲጠየቁ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo, pirezidaantii Liibaanoos Aawun waliin bilbilan dubbataniiru. Marii isaaniitiinis, meeshaaleen waraanaa ykn dhuka’aan garee Hizboollah irraa qabame deebi’ee isaaniif kennamuu akka hin qabne akeekkachiisaniiru. Dabalataanis, dhimmichatti kanneen harka qaban hundi seeratti akka dhiyaatan gaafataniiru.

title: Palestinian youth injured by Israeli shrapnel during raid of occupied West Bank city
english: A young Palestinian man sustained a head injury from shrapnel during an Israeli military operation in Tulkarm on Thursday. During the raid, soldiers detained several individuals and deployed tear gas while using drones for surveillance. Separately, another Palestinian was wounded in a shooting incident involving settlers near the town of Beit Ummar.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በቱልካረም በተካሄደ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አንድ ወጣት ፍልስጤማዊ በደረሰበት የጥይት ፍንጣሪ ለጉዳት ተዳርጓል። በዘመቻው ወቅት ወታደሮቹ በርካታ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ሲሆን፣ አስለቃሽ ጭስ በመጠቀም እና ድሮኖችን በማሰማራት አካባቢውን ተቆጣጥረው ነበር። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ በቤይት ኡማር ከተማ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ ሌላ ጥቃት አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ በአሰፋሪዎች በጥይት ተመቶ ቆስሏል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa magaalaa Tulkaarem keessatti waraanni Israa'el qondaaltummaa gaggeesseen dargaggeessi Falasxiin tokko mataasaa irratti madaa'eera. Duula kana keessatti waraanni kun namoota muraasa to'annoo jala oolchuu fi gaaziin imimmaan fiduu fi xiyyaara sararaa (drone) fayyadamuun naannichatti socho'aa turan. Kana malees, magaalattii Beyt Ummaar biratti namni Falasxiin tokko haleellaa namoota lafa qabatan (settlers) irra ga'een rukutamee miidhameera.

title: Lebanese president asks Rubio to press Israel to halt attacks on country's south
english: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun has requested that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio urge Israel to stop its military operations in southern Lebanon. Aoun specifically called for an end to property destruction and for farmers to be allowed safe access to their land. The request highlights concerns that Israel is failing to honor previously agreed-upon withdrawal commitments in the region.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ፕሬዝዳንት ጆሴፍ አውን የአሜሪካው የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በእስራኤል ላይ ጫና በማሳደር በሊባኖስ ደቡባዊ ክፍል የሚካሄደው ጥቃት እንዲቆም ጠይቀዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ እስራኤል የገባችውን የተኩስ አቁም እና የመውጣት ስምምነት እንድታከብር እንዲሁም ገበሬዎች ወደ እርሻ መሬታቸው እንዲመለሱ እንዲደረግ አሳስበዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ የመጣው እስራኤል በተስማሙት መሰረት ከሊባኖስ መሬት ባለመውጣቷ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Liibaanoos Jooseef Aawun, ministeerri dhimma alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Rubiyooon Israa'eel kibba Liibaanoos keessatti duula waraanaa ishee akka dhaabdu akka dhiibbaa gootan gaafataniiru. Pireezidaantichi Israa'eel waliigaltee kanaan dura mallatteessite kabajtee lafa Liibaanoos irraa akka baatuufi qonnaan bultoonni gara lafa qonnaa isaanii akka deebi'an akka taasisu gaafataniiru. Gaaffiin kun kan dhufe Israa'eel waliigaltee kanaan duraa cabsuun lafa Liibaanoos irratti humnaan turuu ishee hordofeeti.

title: Sanctions to continue until Iran’s ‘coffers empty’, says US Treasury
english: The U.S. Treasury has imposed new sanctions on Iranian entities and individuals to weaken the country's economy. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that the U.S. intends to cut off all financial support for Iran's military operations. The administration plans to maintain this pressure until the Iranian government lacks the funds to continue its activities.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤት የኢራንን ኢኮኖሚ ለማዳከም አዳዲስ ማዕቀቦችን በግለሰቦች እና በተቋማት ላይ ጥሏል። የሀገሪቱ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት እንዳሉት አሜሪካ የኢራንን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የሚደግፉ የገንዘብ ምንጮችን በሙሉ ለማቋረጥ ቁርጠኛ ነች። የኢራን መንግሥት ድርጊቱን እስኪያቆም ድረስ ይህ ጫና ተጠናክሮ እንደሚቀጥል ሚኒስትሩ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri maallaqaa Ameerikaa diinagdee Iraan laaffisuuf jechuun namootaa fi dhaabbilee irratti sagantaa adabbii haaraa diriirseera. Ministeerri maallaqaa Ameerikaa Scott Bessent akka ibsanitti, Ameerikaan sochii waraanaa Iraan deggaru hundumaa dhaabsisuuf murteessiteetti. Bulchiinsi Ameerikaa mootummaan Iraan maallaqa dhabee sochii isaa hamma dhaabuufiitti dhiibbaa kana itti fufsiisuuf akka karoorfate ibsameera.

title: US, Iranian military issue contesting claims over control of Strait of Hormuz
english: The United States and Iran are currently involved in a dispute over the control and security of the Strait of Hormuz. While Iranian military officials claim they fully monitor the area and prevent enemy access, the U.S. Central Command denies these statements and asserts that international partners ensure safe commercial transit. Additionally, the U.S. military has formally rejected Iranian reports regarding alleged attacks on American troops and a maritime incident involving a container ship.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ቁጥጥር እና ደህንነት ዙሪያ በመካከላቸው አለመግባባት ተፈጥሯል። የኢራን ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደሚቆጣጠሩና የጠላት መርከቦችን እንደሚያግዱ ቢናገሩም፣ የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ ይህን ውድቅ በማድረግ ዓለም አቀፍ አጋሮች የንግድ መርከቦች በሰላም እንዲያልፉ እያደረጉ መሆኑን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም አሜሪካ በወታደሮቿ ላይ ተፈጽሟል የተባለውን ጥቃት እና የመርከብ አደጋ ሪፖርቶችን ውድቅ አድርጋለች።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Iraan harka qabaannaa fi nageenya daandii bishaan Hormuz irratti wal-dhabdee keessa jiru. Qondaalonni waraana Iraan naannichaa guutummaatti to'achuu fi mormitoota ittisuu ibsanis, Ajajni Giddugaleessa Amerikaa (Centcom) yaada kana haaluun, tumsi biyyoota garagaraa daldalli akka tasgabbii qabaatu gochaa jiru jedhaniiru. Dabalataanis, Amerikaan gabaasota Iraan kan waraana ishee irratti haleellaa fi balaa markabaa ilaalchisee dhiyeessite dhugummaa hin qabu jechuun haalteetti.

title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills two, minister says
english: A Houthi missile attack on the presidential palace in Aden, Yemen, has resulted in the deaths of two security guards and left several others injured. Government officials confirmed that the Prime Minister and other cabinet members were unharmed during the strike, which targeted the base of the internationally recognized government. The Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for the assault, while government leaders condemned the violence and vowed to continue their military efforts.
amharic: በየመን ኤደን ከተማ በሚገኘው የፕሬዝዳንት ቤተ መንግስት ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ የሮኬት ጥቃት ሁለት የጸጥታ ጠባቂዎች ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የዓለም አቀፉን እውቅና ያገኘው የመንግስት መቀመጫን ያነጣጠረ ቢሆንም፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩና ሌሎች የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ምንም ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰባቸው ተረጋግጧል። የሁቲ ቡድን ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው እራሱ መሆኑን ሲገልጽ፣ የመንግስት አመራሮች ግን ድርጊቱን በማውገዝ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽናቸውን አጠናክረው እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni Houthi magaala Adenitti bakka buufata mootummaa irratti raakata erguunsaanii lubbuu eegduu nageenyaa lamaa galaafateera. Miidhaan kun bakka mootummaan biyyaattii beekamtii argate hojjetutti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, muummeen ministiraa fi ministiroonni biroo miidhaan akka irra hin geenye ibsameera. Houthiin hujii kana fudhateera; mootummaan immoo gocha kana balaaleffachuun, tarkaanfii waraanaa itti fufuuf waadaa galeera.

title: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York
english: Former Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, have formally pleaded not guilty to new US charges involving conspiracy to commit torture and systemic repression. The couple, who are currently being held in New York following their capture during a military operation, argue that they are protected by sovereign immunity. Prosecutors allege that the pair oversaw a violent regime involving severe human rights abuses, including torture against both Venezuelan citizens and Americans. Their trial is set to begin in June 2027.
amharic: የቀድሞው የቬኔዙዌላ መሪ ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ እና ባለቤታቸው ሲሊያ ፍሎሬስ፣ በአሜሪካ መንግስት የቀረቡባቸውን አዳዲስ የማሰቃየት እና የጭቆና ወንጀል ክሶች አልተቀበልንም ብለዋል። ጥንዶቹ በቁጥጥር ስር ውለው በኒውዮርክ እስር ቤት የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ የሉዓላዊነት መብት እንዳላቸው በመከራከር ክሱ እንዲቋረጥ እየጠየቁ ነው። አቃቤ ህጎቹ ጥንዶቹ በዜጎች ላይ ጭካኔ የተሞላበት ድርጊት መፈጸማቸውን ቢከሱም፣ እነሱ ግን የቀረበባቸው ክስ መሰረተ ቢስ ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። የፍርድ ሂደታቸውም በሰኔ 2027 እንዲካሄድ ተቀጥሯል።
oromo: Hogganaan duraanii biyya Veenzuweela Niikolaas Maaduuroo fi haati manaa isaanii Siiliyaa Flores, himata mootummaan Ameerikaa dhiyeesseef kan gara jabinaa fi dararaa irratti hundaa'e kana akka hin raawwatin dubbachuun mormaniiru. Namoonni kunneen duula waraanaa booda qabamanii Niiw Yoorkitti hidhamanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, aangoo biyya bulchuun walqabatu qabaachuun mirga ittisaa (sovereign immunity) akka qaban himatu. Himatamtoonni kunneen lammiilee Veenzuweelaa fi Ameerikaa irratti dararaa raawwachuu isaanii mootummaan Ameerikaa himatuus, isaan garuu himatichi soba akka ta'e dubbatu. Dhaddachi isaanii guyyaa itti dhiyaatan kan qabamee jiruuf ji'a Waxabajjii bara 2027 dha.

title: Dying in ICE custody: Inside one family’s story of heartbreak
english: Ismael Ayala-Uribe, an immigrant living in the U.S. since childhood, passed away in 2025 while detained by ICE after being arrested during a workplace raid. His family believes that inadequate medical care at the detention center caused a treatable infection to become fatal. His tragic death is part of a broader, alarming trend, as 2025 marked the deadliest year on record for individuals held in U.S. immigration custody.
amharic: ኢስማኤል አያላ-ኡሪቤ የተባሉ በልጅነታቸው ወደ አሜሪካ የመጡ ስደተኛ በ2017 ዓ.ም በአሜሪካ የስደተኞች መቆያ ጣቢያ (ICE) እያሉ ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ቤተሰቦቻቸው እንደሚሉት፣ በጣቢያው ውስጥ የነበረው ደካማ የሕክምና አገልግሎት በቀላሉ ሊታከም የሚችል ኢንፌክሽን እንዲባባስና ለሞት እንዲዳርግ አድርጓል። የእሳቸው ሞት በ2017 ዓ.ም በአሜሪካ የስደተኞች መቆያ ጣቢያዎች ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያለው ሰው መሞቱን የሚያሳይ አሳዛኝ ክስተት አካል ነው።
oromo: Ismaa'el Ayaalaa-Uribee kan jedhaman namni ijoollummaa isaanii irraa kaasee Ameerikaa jiraachaa turan, bara 2025 qabamee erga mana hidhaa godaantotaa (ICE) keessa turanii booda du'an. Maatiin isaanii akka jedhanitti, mana hidhichaa keessatti yaaliin fayyaa gahaa waan hin turreef dhibee salphaatti wal'aanamu danda'u gara dhukkuba hamaatti ce'ee lubbuu isaanii dabarse. Duuti isaanii kun bara 2025 manneen hidhaa godaantotaa Ameerikaa keessatti namoonni baay'inaan kan du'an waggaa ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Ethiopian forces expand control in Tigray as militia claims Eritrean losses
english: Ethiopian government forces and allied militias have successfully advanced into several parts of the Tigray region, including the city of Aksum. While local militia groups claim that Eritrean troops have suffered casualties and are retreating across the border, the Eritrean government has officially denied these allegations. Meanwhile, residents in border areas are facing severe humanitarian conditions, such as power and water outages, as the international community expresses concern over the ongoing stability of the region.

With many citizens favoring a shift in legislative control, the Republican Party faces a challenging environment as they attempt to maintain their majority in Congress.

title: Trump ramps up third-country US deportations despite global rights outcry
english: Since taking office in early 2025, President Donald Trump has significantly increased immigration arrests and deportations as part of his promised crackdown. The administration is now sending asylum seekers to third-party countries where they have no personal connections, a practice that human rights organizations strongly criticize. Critics argue this policy is dangerous, lacks legal oversight, and violates international agreements by potentially sending vulnerable individuals to unsafe locations.

title: US judge bars Trump from punishing rights groups for liaising with ICC
english: A US federal judge has issued an injunction preventing the Trump administration from penalizing two human rights organizations for their cooperation with the International Criminal Court. The judge ruled that the administration’s threats to punish these groups likely infringe upon their First Amendment right to free speech. This legal action follows concerns raised by advocacy groups regarding the government's hostile stance toward the ICC.

title: US judge bars Trump from punishing rights groups for liaising with ICC
english: A federal judge has issued an injunction preventing the Trump administration from punishing two American human rights organizations for their work with the International Criminal Court. The judge ruled that these groups are protected by the First Amendment, noting that threatening them with legal action for their advocacy could cause irreparable harm to their freedom of speech. While the administration’s broader sanctions against the ICC remain active, this ruling ensures that groups like Dawn and Taag can continue their advocacy efforts without fear of criminal or civil penalties.
amharic: አንድ የፌደራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) ጋር በሚሰሩ ሁለት የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖች ላይ ቅጣት እንዳይጥል አግደዋል። ዳኛው እንደገለፁት እነዚህ ቡድኖች በህገ መንግስቱ የተጠበቁ የመናገር መብት ስላላቸው፣ ለስራቸው በህግ እንዲጠየቁ መደረጉ መሰረታዊ መብታቸውን የሚጋፋ ነው። ሰፊው የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በICC ላይ የጣለው ማዕቀብ አሁንም በስራ ላይ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ቡድኖቹ ያለምንም ስጋት ስራቸውን እንዲቀጥሉ ያስችላቸዋል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federalaa tokko bulchiinsi Trump garee mirga namootaafi falman lammiilee Ameerikaa lama ta'an irratti hojii isaan mana murtii yakka addunyaa (ICC) waliin hojjetaniif tarkaanfii adabbii akka hin fudhanne dhowwera. Abbaan seerichaa akka jedhetti, gareewwan kun mirga yaada isaanii ibsachuu qabu, kanaafuu hojii isaaniitiif himannaan irratti banamuun mirga isaanii sarbisiisuudha. Bulchiinsi Trump ICC irratti guddisee tarkaanfii kan fudhate ta'us, murteen kun gareewwan akka 'Dawn' fi 'Taag' soda tokko malee hojii isaanii akka itti fufan isaaniif hayyama.

title: Trump calls off livestream for Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad
english: President Trump has cancelled plans to livestream the upcoming execution of Nidal Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist convicted of the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. While the execution will still proceed by firing squad as scheduled, the president noted that many people expressed concerns about making the event public. The families of the victims will still be permitted to attend the execution in person to witness the final judgment.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በ2009 የፎርት ሁድ ጥቃትን ፈፅመዋል በተባሉት የቀድሞ የጦር ኃይሎች የሥነ-አእምሮ ባለሙያ ኒዳል ሃሳን ላይ የሚፈጸመውን የሞት ቅጣት በኢንተርኔት በቀጥታ ለማስተላለፍ የነበረውን ዕቅድ ሰርዘዋል። የሞት ቅጣቱ እንደተያዘለት በጠመንጃ መተኮስ (firing squad) የሚፈጸም ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ክስተት በይፋ መታየቱ ብዙዎችን ስላሳሰበ እንዲሰረዝ ተወስኗል። ሆኖም የተጎጂዎች ቤተሰቦች ፍትህን በአካል ተገኝተው የመመልከት መብት ይኖራቸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp ajjeechaa bara 2009 buufata waraanaa Foort Huuditti raawwatameef itti gaafatamaa kan ta'an, hayyuu sammuu waraanaa duraanii Nidaal Haasaan ajjeesisuuf qophiin ture haqaniiru. Ajjeechaan kun akka karooraatti rasaasaan kan raawwatamu ta'us, dhimmichi ifatti akka hin darbine namoota hedduun mormii waan kaasaniif haalichaa jijjiirameera. Ta'us, maatiin namoota miidhamanii sirnicharratti argamanii murticha ijaan arguuf mirga akka qaban ibsameera.

title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
english: A tragic school roof collapse in Peshawar, Pakistan, has resulted in the deaths of at least 33 students and one teacher. The incident occurred when a top-floor classroom ceiling gave way, causing a chain reaction that destroyed floors below and trapped many children. Authorities have arrested the school's owner and are currently investigating whether the building's construction violated safety standards.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ፔሻዋር ከተማ በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት ጣራ በመውደቁ ምክንያት ቢያንስ 33 ተማሪዎች እና አንድ መምህር ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የደረሰው የላይኛው ፎቅ ጣራ በመፍረሱና በታችኛው ክፍል የነበሩትን ወለሎች በመጫኑ በርካታ ተማሪዎች ፍርስራሽ ስር እንዲቀበሩ በማድረጉ ነው። የትምህርት ቤቱ ባለቤት በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ ሕንፃው የደህንነት መስፈርቶችን አሟልቶ የተሰራ መሆኑን ለማጣራት ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ነው።
oromo: Magaala Peshawaar kan biyya Paakistaanitti mana barnootaa tokko keessatti cinaan suufii kufuun isaa barattoota 33 fi barsiisaa tokko lubbuun akka darban taasiseera. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo suufiin kutaawwan barnootaa olii caccabee kufu, dachaa gaditti argamanis waliin jeeqee ijoollee hedduu jala galcheedha. Abbaan mana barnootichaa qabamanii jiru; akkasumas ijaarsi mana barnootichaa seera nageenyaa eeggatee kan ijaarame ta'uu fi dhiisuu isaa irratti qorannoon eegalameera.

title: Syrian court sentences two to death over 2025 coastal violence
english: A Syrian court in Aleppo has issued death sentences to two former Bashar al-Assad supporters for inciting sectarian violence during an uprising in early 2025. Additionally, the court sentenced members of the new government’s security forces to prison terms for their involvement in the killings and torture of Alawite civilians. These rulings stem from a government investigation into the deaths of over 1,400 people during attacks in coastal regions last year.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት እ.ኤ.አ. በ2025 መጀመሪያ ላይ በተከሰተው አመጽ የሃይማኖት ግጭትን በማነሳሳት የቀድሞው የአሳድ መንግስት ደጋፊ የሆኑ ሁለት ግለሰቦችን በሞት ቀጣ። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም የአሁኑ መንግስት የጸጥታ ሃይል አባላት በአላዊት ንጹሃን ዜጎች ላይ በፈጸሙት ግድያ እና እንግልት የረጅም ጊዜ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። እነዚህ ፍርዶች ባለፈው ዓመት በሶሪያ የባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢዎች ከ1,400 በላይ ሰዎችን ሕይወት የቀጠፈውን ግጭት ለመመርመር በተቋቋመ ኮሚቴ ግኝት ላይ የተመሰረቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Mana murtii Sooriyaa magaalaa Halabitti argamu, bara 2025 jalqaba irratti jeequmsa amantii kakaasuu fi walitti bu'iinsa uumuu jechuun gartuu Bashaar al-Asaad duraanii lama irratti adabbii du'aa murteesseera. Kana malees, miseensonni humnoota nageenyaa mootummaa ammaa lammilee saba Alawite irratti ajjeechaa fi dararaa raawwachuu isaaniitiin hidhaan cimaan itti murtaa'eera. Murteen kun qorannoo mootummaan bara darbe naannoo qarqara galaanaa Sooriyaatti namoota 1,400 ol ajjeesise irratti taasifame hordofee kan kenname dha.

title: French football body urges fans and students to keep politics out of stadiums
english: The French Football Federation's ethics committee has officially requested that fans and students refrain from bringing political protests into stadiums. This follows several instances where supporters displayed banners criticizing the police response to recent nationwide student demonstrations. Officials emphasize that sports should remain neutral, strictly prohibiting political symbols or messages to ensure stadiums serve as places for unity rather than conflict.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን የስነ-ምግባር ኮሚቴ ደጋፊዎች እና ተማሪዎች የፖለቲካ ተቃውሞዎችን ወደ ስታዲየም እንዳያመጡ አሳሰበ። ይህ ጥሪ የተላለፈው በቅርብ ጊዜ በሀገሪቱ በተካሄዱ የተማሪዎች ሰልፎች ላይ የፖሊስን አያያዝ የሚተቹ ባነሮች በስታዲየም ውስጥ መታየታቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። ባለስልጣናት ስፖርት ገለልተኛ መሆን እንዳለበት በመግለጽ፣ ስታዲየሞች ለፖለቲካ ግጭት ሳይሆን ለመዝናኛ የሚውሉበት ቦታ እንዲሆኑ ለማድረግ ማንኛውም አይነት የፖለቲካ መግለጫዎች የተከለከሉ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni naamusa federeeshinii kubbaa miilaa Faransaayi, taphataafi barattoonni mormii siyaasaa gara istaadiyoomii akka hin geessine dhaame. Kunis erga taphattoonni mormii barattootaa biyyattii irratti poolisiin fudhate balaaleffatu agarsiisanii booda kan dhufedha. Qaamoleen mootummaa ispoortiin giddu-galeessa ta'uu akka qabu ibsuun, istaadiyoomiin bakka walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa utuu hin taane, bakka gammachuu ta'uu akka qabuuf mallattooleen siyaasaa kamuu akka hin dhiyaanne dhorkaniiru.

title: Delegates walk out as Israeli president addresses summit
english: Representatives from more than ten nations staged a protest by walking out during a speech by Israeli President Isaac Herzog at a summit in Azerbaijan. Diplomats from several countries, including Iran, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan, exited the venue as he began his address. This collective action highlights the significant diplomatic tension surrounding Israel's recent military activities.
amharic: በአዘርባጃን በተካሄደ ስብሰባ ላይ የእስራኤሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ይስሐቅ ሄርዞግ ንግግር እያደረጉ ሳለ ከ10 በላይ አገራት የተወከሉ ዲፕሎማቶች ተቃውሟቸውን በመግለጽ ከአዳራሹ ወጥተዋል። ከቱርክ፣ ከፓኪስታን፣ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ከኢራን እና ከሌሎች አገራት የተወከሉ ባለስልጣናት ንግግሩ ሲጀመር አዳራሹን ለቀው ወጥተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በቅርቡ በእስራኤል እየተካሄደ ካለው ጦርነት ጋር በተያያዘ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ajajoonni fi bakka bu'oonni biyyoota kudhan ol ta'an, walga'ii Azerbaajanitti gaggeeffamaa ture irratti pirezidaantii Israa'el Isaak Herzoog yommuu haasaa gochaa turanitti, mormii isaanii ibsuuf kutaa walga'ii sana gadi dhiisanii ba'aniiru. Biyyoonni akka Turkii, Paakistaan, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Iraan kanneen keessatti argaman yommuu haasaan kun jalqabamu bakka walga'ichaa gadhiisanii ba'aniiru. Gochi kun haala waraana Israa'el waliin walqabatee dippilomaasii idil-addunyaa irratti dhiibbaan jiraachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Russian jet-powered drone hits supermarket in Ukraine’s Odesa
english: A Russian jet-powered drone struck a supermarket in the Odesa region of Ukraine on Thursday. The attack resulted in at least four injuries and caused a large fire at the scene. Ukrainian officials reported the incident as part of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በዩክሬን ኦዴሳ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኝ አንድ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ የሩሲያ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን ጥቃት አድርሷል። ጥቃቱ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎችን ያቆሰለ ሲሆን በቦታው ላይ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትሏል። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ይህ ድርጊት አሁን እየተካሄደ ካለው የጦርነት ሂደት አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa darbe, xiyyaarri qunxurruu (drone) kan Raashiyaa, magaalaa Odesa kan biyya Yuukireen keessatti suuqii tokko rukuteera. Miidhaan kun namoota afur ol irratti miidhaa qaamaa geessiseera akkasumas ibidda cimaa uumeera. Aangoonni Yuukireen akka ibsanitti, miidhaan kun waraana ammaa geggeeffamaa jiru keessatti kan dhalate dha.

title: US teen held over Hindu temple attack plot: Is anti-Indian racism rising?
english: A 19-year-old white supremacist from Illinois, Alexandros Paporakis, was arrested for allegedly plotting a mass shooting at a Hindu temple. Prosecutors state he expressed hatred toward Indian people and other minority groups in a manifesto and had attempted to carry out an attack with a rifle. The suspect was taken into custody after his weapon malfunctioned and coworkers reported his threats to the police.
amharic: አሌክሳንድሮስ ፓፖራኪስ የተባለ የ19 ዓመት ወጣት በኢሊኖይ ግዛት በሚገኝ የሂንዱ ቤተ መቅደስ ላይ የሽብር ጥቃት ለመፈጸም በማቀድ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። ተጠርጣሪው በሕንድ ተወላጆች እና በሌሎች አናሳ ቡድኖች ላይ ጥላቻ እንደሚሰማው በሚገልጽ ጽሑፍ ውስጥ የጥቃት ዕቅዱን አዘጋጅቶ ነበር። መሣሪያው በመበላሸቱ ምክንያት ጥቃቱን ሳይፈጽም ቀርቶ፣ የሥራ ባልደረቦቹ ለፖሊስ ጥቆማ በመስጠታቸው በቁጥጥር ስር ሊውል ችሏል።
oromo: dargaggoon umriin isaa 19 kan ta’e fi ilaalcha 'white supremacist' qabu tokko, mana sagadaa Hindu tokkorratti weerara gaggeessuuf karoorfate ture jedhamee Illinois keessatti qabameera. Namni kun namoota Hinduu fi gareewwan biroo irratti jibba qabaachuusaa barreeffama inni qopheesse keessatti ibseera. Meeshaan inni itti fayyadamaa ture erga itti cufamee booda, hiriyyoonni hojiisaa poolisii beeksisuun isaa akka qabamu godhaniiru.

title: Ukraine to restart strikes on Russian oil refineries, Zelensky says
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced that Ukraine will resume attacks on Russian oil refineries after a brief pause requested by the United States. Zelensky accused the U.S. of withdrawing critical intelligence and interfering with Starlink services to pressure Kyiv into stopping these strikes. Despite a proposed energy ceasefire, Ukraine claims Russia has continued to target its own power infrastructure, leading Zelensky to feel betrayed by American leadership.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጥያቄ መሰረት ለአጭር ጊዜ አቁመውት የነበረውን የሩሲያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። ዘለንስኪ፣ አሜሪካ በኪቭ ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር ስትል የስለላ መረጃዎችን ማጋራቷን እንዳቆመች እና የስታርሊንክ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎትን እንደገደበች ከሰዋል። የቀረበውን የኢነርጂ ተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ሩሲያ ባለማክበሯ እና የዩክሬንን የኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ማጥቃቷን በመቀጠሏ፣ ዘለንስኪ በአሜሪካ መንግስት እንደተከዱ ይሰማቸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski, gaaffii Ameerikaatiin yeroo gabaabaaf dhaabamee ture, miidhaan buufataalee qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti gaggeeffamu akka itti fufu ibsaniiru. Zeelenski, Ameerikaan Yukreen haleellaa kana akka dhaabdu dhiibbaa gochuuf jecha odeeffannoo basaasaa akka isaan dhorkatte fi tajaajila intarneetii Staarliinkis akka ittistee himataniiru. Walii galtee dhaabbii waraana fayyaa irratti biyyoonni lameen walii galuu baatanis, Raashiyaan buufataalee elektirikii Yukreen irratti haleellaa geggeessuu ishee kan itti fufte ta'uu fi kanaanis Zeelenski mootummaa Ameerikaan gatamuu akka itti dhaga'ame ibsaniiru.

title: Two dead in Istanbul after heaviest rainfall in 84 years, governor says
english: Istanbul recently experienced its most intense rainfall in 84 years, resulting in two fatalities and widespread flooding across the city. Authorities have evacuated nearly 600 stranded residents and have urged citizens to stay home as dangerous conditions persist. To ensure public safety, schools have been closed and administrative leave has been granted to certain government employees.
amharic: ኢስታንቡል በ84 ዓመታት ታሪኳ ከፍተኛውን የዝናብ መጠን በማስተናገዷ ምክንያት በደረሰው ጎርፍ ሁለት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ወደ 600 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን ከጎርፍ የታደጉ ሲሆን፣ ሁኔታው አደገኛ በመሆኑ ነዋሪዎች ቤት እንዲቆዩ አሳስበዋል። ለሕዝብ ደህንነት ሲባል ትምህርት ቤቶች ተዘግተዋል እንዲሁም አንዳንድ የመንግሥት ሠራተኞች ፈቃድ እንዲወስዱ ተወስኗል።
oromo: ኢስታንቡል ባለፉት 84 ዓመታት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ከባድ ዝናብ ሳቢያ በተከሰተ ጎርፍ ሁለት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ወደ 600 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን ከአደጋው የታደጉ ሲሆን፣ ሁኔታው አደገኛ በመሆኑ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዳይወጡ መክረዋል። ለሕዝብ ደህንነት ሲባል ትምህርት ቤቶች እንዲዘጉ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ የመንግሥት ሠራተኞችም የዕረፍት ፈቃድ እንዲወስዱ ተወስኗል።

title: Eight crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
english: A San Marino-flagged oil tanker named Wine Trader caught fire after being struck by drones off the coast of Romania, leaving eight of its 12 crew members missing. Authorities have launched a major rescue mission using helicopters and boats despite challenging weather conditions. This incident follows a similar recent attack near Bulgaria, prompting Romanian and Bulgarian leaders to discuss potential security consultations with NATO.
amharic: የሳን ማሪኖ ባንዲራ የሚውለበለብበት የነዳጅ ጫኝ መርከብ ሮማኒያ የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በድሮን ጥቃት ተመትቶ በእሳት በመያያዙ 12ቱ የሰራተኞች አባላት ስምንቱ የት እንዳሉ አልታወቀም። አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታ ቢኖርም ባለስልጣናት በሄሊኮፕተር እና በጀልባዎች ታግዞ የፍለጋ እና የማዳን ስራ እያከናወኑ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ጥቃት በቡልጋሪያ አቅራቢያ ከተፈጸመ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃት ጋር ተያይዞ የሮማኒያ እና የቡልጋሪያ መሪዎች ከኔቶ ጋር የጸጥታ ምክክር ለማድረግ እየመከሩ ነው።
oromo: Markaan boba'aa kan alaabaa San Maariino qabu kan Wine Trader jedhamu, daangaa biyya Roomeeniyaatti miidhamaa isaa erga haleelamee booda ibiddaan gubachuu isaa hordofee, hojjettoota 12 keessaa saddeet gadi ba'anii badaniiru. Haalli qilleensaa yoo rakkisaa ta'eyyuu, aanga'oonni helicopterootaafi dooniiwwan fayyadamuun hojii barbaachaafi baraarsa bal'aa jalqabaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan biyya Bulgaariyaatti muudate waliin wal fakkaatu waan ta'eef, hogganoonni Roomeeniyaafi Bulgaariyaa dhimma nageenyaa irratti NATO waliin mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Brazil's Congress approves shorter working week in win for Lula
english: The Brazilian Congress has passed a significant constitutional amendment to reduce the standard workweek from 44 to 40 hours while ensuring workers receive two days off without any reduction in pay. This major reform, supported by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is expected to benefit approximately 30 million employees and has received overwhelming public approval. Even opposition figures, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, eventually voted in favor of the measure, which is seen as a strategic political win shortly before the upcoming presidential runoff.
amharic: የብራዚል ፓርላማ የስራ ቀናትን በመቀነስ በሳምንት ውስጥ ከ44 ሰዓታት ወደ 40 ሰዓታት እንዲያድግ የሚያደርግ ህግ አጽድቋል። ይህ አዲስ ህግ ሰራተኞች ደመወዛቸው ሳይቀንስ በሳምንት ሁለት ቀናት እረፍት እንዲያገኙ ያስችላቸዋል። በፕሬዝዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ የተደገፈው ይህ ለውጥ ከ30 ሚሊዮን በላይ ለሚሆኑ ሰራተኞች ተጠቃሚ እንደሚያደርግ ይጠበቃል። በቅርቡ በሚካሄደው የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር ላይ ትልቅ ተጽእኖ ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይታሰባል።
oromo: Mana maree biyya Brazil hojjettoonni torbanitti sa’aatii 44 hojjechaa turan gara 40tti akka gad xiqqatu seerri jijjiiramee ragga’eera. Seerri haaraan kun hojjettoonni mindaan isaanii osoo hin hir’atin torbanitti guyyaa lama guutuu boqochuu akka danda’an taasisa. Pirezidaant Luwiiz Iinaasiyo Luula da Silvaa kan deggaran kun, hojjettoota miliyoona 30 ol ta’aniif fayyadamoo kan godhuufi jijjiirama guddaa ta’eera. Murtichi kun filannoo pirezidaantummaa kan dhufu keessatti shoora guddaa taphata jedhamee eegama.

title: US-Iran stalemate: What are Trump’s next military options?
english: President Donald Trump has promised to delay any military strikes against Iran until after the November midterm elections, despite rising tensions and increased Iranian attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Although the US maintains a significant military advantage, previous efforts have failed to secure the region or stabilize global energy prices, which have spiked due to the conflict. Military analysts are currently evaluating the potential risks and outcomes of various strategies the administration may pursue once the election period concludes.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ተከትሎ፣ ከህዳር ወር የአጋማሽ ምርጫ በፊት በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደማይሰነዝሩ አስታውቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን አሜሪካ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ አቅም ቢኖራትም፣ እስካሁን የተወሰዱ እርምጃዎች የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረትን ለመቆጣጠር ወይም በክልሉ ሰላም ለማስፈን አልቻሉም። የጦርነት ተንታኞች ምርጫው እንዳለቀ ትራምፕ ሊወስዷቸው ስለሚችሉ አማራጭ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እና ስለሚያስከትሉት ውጤት እየመከሩበት ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Doonaald Tiraamp, naannoo waraana Hormuz keessatti waldhabdeen dabaluus isaa hordofee, filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa Sadaasaa dura Iran irratti haleellaa waraanaa akka hin banne dubbataniiru. Ameerikaan humna waraanaa cimaa qabaattus, tarkaanfiileen hanga ammaatti fudhataman gatii boba’aa tasgabbeessuuf ykn naannichatti nagaa buusuuf hin gargaarre. Xiinxaltoonni waraanaa, erga filannoon xumuramee booda Tiraamp tarkaanfii waraanaa akkamii fudhachuu akka danda'anfi bu'aa inni qabaachuu danda'u irratti gorsa kennaa jiru.

title: Syrian authorities arrest main suspect in 2013 Baniyas mass killings
english: Syrian authorities have captured Ali Kayali, also known as Mihrac Ural, who is the primary suspect in the 2013 mass killings in Baniyas and Bayda. He was detained by intelligence officials while attempting to flee across the border. Kayali previously commanded a pro-government militia during the Bashar al-Assad administration.
amharic: የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት እ.ኤ.አ. በ2013 በባኒያስ እና በባይዳ ከተሞች ለተፈጸመው የጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ ዋና ተጠርጣሪ የሆኑትን አሊ ካያሊን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ተጠርጣሪው ድንበር አቋርጠው ለማምለጥ ሲሞክሩ በስለላ ድርጅት አባላት ተይዘዋል። ካያሊ የቀድሞው የሶሪያ መንግስትን ይደግፍ የነበረ ታጣቂ ቡድንን ይመሩ እንደነበር ይታወቃል።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa namicha bara 2013 magaalaawwan Baaniyaas fi Baydaa keessatti ajjeechaa jumlaa raawwate jedhamee shakkamu, Alii Kaayaalii qabee jira. Namichi kun daangaa ce’ee baqachuuf yaalaa osoo jiruu humnoota basaasaatiin qabame. Kaayaaliin yeroo bulchiinsa Baashar al-Asaaditti garee waraanaa mootummaa deggaru hogganaa ture.

title: Fighting in Yemen intensifies: What’s the latest on the battlefield?
english: Violent conflict in Yemen has escalated as Houthi rebels and the Saudi-led coalition exchange frequent aerial attacks. The Houthis have intensified their targeting of Saudi oil facilities and airports, leading to casualties and significant infrastructure damage. This surge in fighting marks a breakdown of the 2022 ceasefire, with both sides engaged in a retaliatory cycle of military strikes.
amharic: በየመን ያለው ግጭት በሁቲ አማፂያን እና በሳዑዲ በሚመራው ጥምረት መካከል እየተባባሰ መጥቷል። ሁቲዎች በሳዑዲ የአየር ማረፊያዎች እና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ ያደረሱት ጥቃት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና ከፍተኛ ውድመት አስከትሏል። ይህ የተጠናከረ ጥቃት እ.ኤ.አ በ2022 የተደረሰውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በመጣስ ሁለቱ ወገኖች የአጸፋ እርምጃቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Yemen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru loltoota Huutii fi waldaa Saudiin durfamu gidduutti daran hammaatee jira. Huutiin buufataalee xiyyaaraa fi iddoowwan qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Saudi Arabaa irratti haleellaa geggeessaniin lubbuun namootaa darbee miidhaan guddaanis qaqqabeera. Babal'achuu haleellaa kanaatiin waligalteen dhaabbii waraanaa bara 2022 kahuun, gam lamaanuu walfalmii haleellaa ijaa baasuutti seenanii jiru.

title: FIFA set for rule change after Balogun red card row at the World Cup: reports
english: FIFA is planning to revise its disciplinary regulations following widespread criticism over the controversial decision to overturn a red card given to U.S. player Folarin Balogun. During the recent World Cup, political intervention led to the reversal of his automatic suspension, causing significant backlash from football officials and global experts. The FIFA council is now meeting to vote on a new rule that would officially prevent disciplinary committees from interfering with match-related suspensions in the future.
amharic: ፊፋ በአሜሪካዊው ተጫዋች ፎላሪን ባሎጉን ላይ የተሰጠውን ቀይ ካርድ በፖለቲካዊ ጣልቃገብነት በመሻሩ በተነሳው ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ምክንያት የዲሲፕሊን ህጎቹን ለማሻሻል አቅዷል። በዓለም ዋንጫው ወቅት የተደረገው ይህ ውሳኔ በብዙ የֆეხ볼 ባለሙያዎችና አመራሮች ዘንድ ትልቅ ውዝግብ አስነስቶ ነበር። አሁን የፊፋ ምክር ቤት ቀይ ካርድ እና ተያያዥ ቅጣቶች ወደፊት በዲሲፕሊን ኮሚቴዎች እንዳይቀየሩ የሚከለክል አዲስ ህግ ላይ ለመምከር ተሰብስቧል።
oromo: FIFA taphataa Ameerikaa Folarin Balogun irratti kaartii diimaa kenname dhiibbaa siyaasaatiin haqamuusaatiin mormii guddaan mudachuu hordofee, seera isaa haaromsuuf karoorfateera. Murtiin kun tapha Waancaa Addunyaa irratti akka taphataan kun hinfirraanne taasisuunsaa, hoogganoota kubbaa miillaafi ogeeyyii hedduu biratti mormii kaasee ture. Amma koreen FIFA murtee kaartii diimaa fi adabbiiwwan walqabatan gara fuulduraatti koree disipliniin akka hinjijjiiramne dhowwu seera haaraa irratti mari'achuuf walga'eera.

title: Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia could be postponed by a year amid Houthi attacks
english: The 2027 Asian Cup scheduled to be held in Saudi Arabia may be delayed by one year due to ongoing security concerns and Houthi missile attacks. The Asian Football Confederation is currently monitoring the situation and plans to make a final decision by the end of November. While officials hope to keep the tournament on schedule, they are prepared to postpone the event to 2028 if regional instability continues to threaten participant safety.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ ሊካሄድ የታቀደው የ2027 የእስያ ዋንጫ በሀገሪቱ ላይ እየተካሄዱ ባሉ የሁቲዎች ጥቃቶች እና የፀጥታ ስጋቶች ምክንያት በአንድ ዓመት ሊራዘም ይችላል። የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ሁኔታውን በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ሲሆን የመጨረሻ ውሳኔውን በኖቬምበር መጨረሻ ለማሳወቅ አቅዷል። ውድድሩ በተያዘለት ጊዜ እንዲካሄድ ቢፈለግም፣ የፀጥታው ሁኔታ ካልተሻሻለ ውድድሩን ወደ 2028 ለማዛወር ዝግጅት እየተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Qophiin Waancaa Eeshiyaa bara 2027 Saudii Arabiyaatti gaggeeffamuuf karoorfame, haleellaa garee Huutii fi dhimmoota nageenyaa biyyattii mudateen walqabatee waggaa tokkoof dabarfamuu danda'a. Koreen kubbaa miilaa Eeshiyaa haala yeroo hordofaa jiruufi dhuma ji'a Sadaasaa irratti murtoo xumuraa kan dabarsan ta'a. Taphoonni kunneen yeroo qabameefitti akka gaggeeffaman hawwu illee, rakkoon nageenyaa yoo itti fufe qophiin kun gara bara 2028tti dabarfamuuf qophiidha.

title: Retired US generals call on Pentagon to cancel 'barbaric' execution livestream
english: A group of 72 retired high-ranking US military officers has urged the Pentagon to stop its plan to livestream the upcoming execution of Nidal Hasan, the soldier responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. The retired officials argue that broadcasting the execution is a cruel act that would humiliate the military and potentially turn the perpetrator into a martyr for his extremist views. While some officials in the current administration are reconsidering the decision, President Trump has previously expressed support for the public broadcast.
amharic: የጡረታ የወጡ 72 ከፍተኛ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ወታደራዊ መኮንኖች፣ ፔንታጎን በፎርት ሁድ የጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ ፈጻሚው በኒዳል ሃሳን ላይ የሚፈጸመውን የሞት ቅጣት በቀጥታ ስርጭት እንዳያስተላልፍ ጠይቀዋል። ጡረተኞቹ መኮንኖች ይህ ድርጊት ኢ-ሰብአዊ እና ለወታደራዊ ክብር የማይመጥን መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ የቅጣቱ በቀጥታ መተላለፍ ወንጀለኛውን ሰማዕት አስመስሎ ሊያቀርብ እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። በአስተዳደሩ ውስጥ ያሉ አንዳንድ አካላት በወሰኑት ላይ እንደገና እያሰቡ ቢሆንም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ለሃሳቡ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ቀደም ሲል ገልጸው ነበር።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Ameerikaa 72 ta'an kan hojiirraa ba'an, Pentagon guyyaa ajjeechaa Nidal Hasan kan bara 2009 Fort Hood irratti raawwatamee ture, sagantaa bilbilan (livestream) akka hin dabarsine gaafataniiru. Qondaalonni kunneen tarkaanfiin kun kan namummaarraa fagaatee fi ulfina waraanaa kan xureessuudha, akkasumas namichi kun akka gootaa akka ilaalamu gochuu danda'a jedhaniiru. Mootummaan Trump irratti yaada adda addaa kan qabu ta'us, hanga ammaatti murtiin dhumaa waan hin kennamneef, hogganoonni kunneen dhimma kana akka dhaaban dhiibbaa gochaa jiru.

title: White House defends new press secretary amid questions about her legal credentials
english: The White House is supporting its new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, following public skepticism regarding her legal qualifications. While she claims to have practiced international law, reports indicate she never passed the bar exam necessary to be a licensed attorney in the United States. A watchdog group has now requested an investigation into whether she misled the public about her credentials.
amharic: የነጭ ቤተ መንግስት አዲሷ የፕሬስ ፀሐፊ ኬቲ ዘካሪያ የህግ ባለሙያ መሆኗን በተመለከተ ለተነሱ ጥያቄዎች ድጋፍ እየሰጠ ነው። ምንም እንኳን እርሷ በዓለም አቀፍ የህግ ዘርፍ እንደሰራች ብትናገርም፣ በአሜሪካ የህግ ባለሙያ ለመሆን የሚያስፈልገውን የፈቃድ ፈተና ማለፏ አልተረጋገጠም። አንድ የክትትል ቡድን እርሷ የህግ ባለሙያ መሆኗን በተመለከተ የውሸት መረጃ ሰጥታ ሊሆን ይችላል በሚል ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጥያቄ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Mana Maree Adii (White House) kan ta'an gabaasaa fi dubbi-himaa haarawa isaanii Katie Zacharia irratti mormiin erga ka'ee booda, isheen ga'umsa akka qabdu ibsuun deggarsa kennaniiru. Zacharia seera idil-addunyaa irratti hojjettee akka turte kan dubbattu ta'us, biyya Ameerikaa keessatti abukaatummaan hojjechuuf qormaata barbaachisu darbuu ishee ragaan hin jiru. Gareen mirga namoomaa fi adeemsa sirrii hordofu tokko, isheen waa'ee guddina barnoota ishee irratti uummata gowwoomsuu ishee qorannoon akka mirkanaa'u gaafateera.

title: 'Nowhere to escape' - Indonesians share footage of orange haze blanketing towns
english: Severe wildfires in Indonesia have caused a thick, hazardous orange smog to engulf the city of Palangka Raya. Pollution levels have spiked to four times the dangerous threshold, severely affecting residents and neighboring countries like Singapore and Malaysia. Authorities believe that agricultural slash-and-burn practices are a primary cause of this intense environmental crisis.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ በሚገኙ የደን ቃጠሎዎች ምክንያት የፓላንካ ራያ ከተማን ጥቅጥቅ ያለ አደገኛ ብርቱካናማ ጭስ አጥለቅልቋታል። የአየር ብክለት መጠኑ ከተፈቀደው አደገኛ ደረጃ በአራት እጥፍ በላይ በመጨመሩ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን እና በአካባቢው ያሉ አገራትን እያማረረ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ከባድ የጭስ አደጋ ያደረሰው በዋናነት የእርሻ መሬትን ለማጽዳት የሚደረገው የደን ቃጠሎ ዘዴ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa Indoneesiyaatti ka’e hordofee, magaalaan Palangka Raya qilleensa cimaa fi bifaan isaa burtukaana’u ta’een ukkaamamee jira. Sadarkaan faalama qilleensaa daangaa balaa irraa dachaa afuriin ol waan darbeef, namoota miliyoonaan lakka’aman fi biyyoota ollaa akka Singappoor fi Maleeziyaatti rakkoo hamaa uumeera. Qaamoleen mootummaa balaa kanaaf sababa guddaan tooftaa qonnaa bosona gubanii lafa qopheessuu akka ta’e ibsaniiru.

title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
english: Finance ministers and central bank governors from G20 nations are meeting in Bangkok to discuss the global economic instability caused by the ongoing war involving Iran. The event is being held alongside annual World Bank and IMF meetings to address rising energy costs and uncertain financial outlooks. Despite the US currently holding the G20 presidency, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will not attend due to conflicting domestic obligations.
amharic: የG20 አባል ሀገራት የፋይናንስ ሚኒስትሮች እና የባንክ ገዥዎች በኢራን ጦርነት ምክንያት እየተፈጠረ ባለው ዓለም አቀፍ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ዙሪያ ለመምከር በባንኮክ ተገናኝተዋል። ስብሰባው ከአለም ባንክ እና ከዓለም አቀፍ የገንዘብ ድርጅት (IMF) አመታዊ ጉባኤዎች ጋር በአንድ ላይ እየተካሄደ ሲሆን፣ በዋናነት የኃይል ዋጋ መናር እና የኢኮኖሚ አለመረጋጋትን ለመፍታት ያለመ ነው። የG20 ሊቀመንበር የሆነችው አሜሪካን በመወከል መገኘት የነበረባቸው የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት በአገር ውስጥ ጉዳዮች ምክንያት በስብሰባው ላይ እንደማይገኙ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Ministiroonni faayinaansii fi bulchitoonni baankiiwwan giddu galeessaa biyyoota G20 waraana Iraan waliin walqabatee dinagdee addunyaarratti dhiibbaa uumame mari'achuuf magaala Bangkokitti walga'aniiru. Walga'iin kun walga'ii waggaa Baankii Addunyaa fi IMF waliin kan adeemsifamaa jiru yoo ta'u, gatii anniisaa dabalaa jiru fi tasgabbii dhabuu dinagdee irratti xiyyeeffata. Yaa'ii kana kan hoogganaa jirtu Ameerikaan ta'us, ministirri faayinaansii ishee Scott Bessent dhimmoota biyya keessaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu qabaniin walqabatee walga'icha irra hin jiraatan.

title: Is Lamine Yamal’s Barcelona record better than Messi’s as a teenager?
english: Nineteen-year-old Lamine Yamal is currently outperforming Lionel Messi’s teenage statistics at Barcelona, recording 17 goal contributions in his first 10 games this season. While Messi managed 14 contributions during his first Ballon d'Or campaign at the same age, Yamal's performance has also slightly surpassed Kylian Mbappe’s early record. These impressive achievements have made Yamal a strong contender for the upcoming Ballon d'Or award.
amharic: የ19 ዓመቱ ላሚን ያማል በባርሴሎና ቤት ባሳየው ድንቅ ብቃት፣ በዘንድሮ የውድድር ዘመን በመጀመሪያዎቹ 10 ጨዋታዎች 17 ግቦችን በማስቆጠር እና በማቀበል የሊዮኔል ሜሲን በጉርምስና ዕድሜ የነበረውን ክብረ ወሰን በልጧል። ሜሲ በ19 ዓመቱ የመጀመሪያውን የባሎንዶር ሽልማት ሲያሸንፍ በነበረበት ወቅት 14 ግቦችን ብቻ ነበር የተሳተፈው። ያማል በአሁኑ ወቅት የፈረንሳዩን ኮከብ ኪሊያን ኤምባፔንም ቁጥር በትንሹ በመብለጡ፣ ለቀጣዩ የባሎንዶር ሽልማት ዋና ተፎካካሪ ሆኗል።
oromo: Lammiin Yaamaal kan umuriin isaa waggaa 19 ta'e, barruu kana keessatti taphataa Baarseloonaa kan ta'e Lionel Messi umuriisaa dargaggummaa keessa qabu caalee argameera. Yaamaal taphoota 10 sadarkaa kilabii goolii 8 lakkoofsiisee fi 9 akka gumaachu ergeera, kunis riikordii Messi kan yeroo jalqabaaf Badhaasa Ballon d'Or mo'ate sana caala. Raawwiin Yaamaal kun kan Kylian Mbappe yeroo umuriin isaa 19 ture sanaa xiqqoo kan caalu ta'uun, badhaasa Ballon d'Or dhufuuf akka dorgomaa cimaatti akka fudhatamu isa taasiseera.
